tail:
**Batch 122 is authored.** The A page has three items and the B page has the qubit example, at dependency levels 0, 0, 1, and 2. All four Step 1 readiness records are current and `ready`.

The helper proves the finite matrix entropy derivative using the planned divided-difference and cyclic-trace route, with the matrix remainder justified. The plan and design agree on page scope and prerequisites.

The [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-122.notes.md), [manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-122.pages.json), [source coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-122.coverage.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-122.proof-contracts.json), and [cross-batch dependency record](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-122.cross-batch-dependencies.json) are complete. Full-text coverage records Watrous, Wall, and Wilde ([Watrous](https://jhwatrous.github.io/TQI.pdf), [Wall](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1105.3445), [Wilde](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1106.1445v8)).

Scoped author checks pass: proof contracts, proof layout, precheck, render, content policy, dependency checks, coverage, and source fetch verification. The shared run-level dependency record is stale after the authored manifest changed, so I left it untouched. The run-wide checker also reports empty inventories and two unrelated level mismatches outside this batch; details are in the notes.
